title: Gothic Christmas Digital Paper
author: Digital Curio
description:
These lovely antique backgrounds feature dark Gothic patterns in a Christmas theme – skulls, reindeer, ornate gold accents, and holly. Perfect for decoupage, junk journals, scrapbooking, Christmas cards, invitations or web backgrounds. Each image measures 12 x 12 inches (30.5 x 30.5 cm) and has 300 dpi resolution for the best quality printing. These are in seamless format, making them ideal for large prints, fabrics and web backgrounds! There are 2 ornate gold clipart borders as well, measuring 12 inches wide in PNG format.
This digital product includes:
– 18 seamless digital papers in JPEG format
– Size: 12″ x 12″ or 3600 x 3600 pixels
– Resolution: 300 dpi
– 2 gold decorative borders in PNG format, 300 dpi
